# Quero

> Quero is an AI workspace for research, browsing, file management, tool integrations, and multi-step automation.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://quero.indevs.in/): Overview of Quero.
- [Privacy](https://quero.indevs.in/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://quero.indevs.in/terms): Terms of service.

## Capabilities

- Research and summarization.
- Web browsing.
- Document generation.
- Code writing.
- API and MCP integrations.
- Workflow automation.
- Persistent context and memory.
